profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Microsoft | A.I Innovator| Veteran | MSSA Aluimni
profile.summary:
My goal everyday is to make sure I learn something new, with this in mind it seemed only fitting that I ended up having a dream to become a Software Developer. Microsoft taught me during their 18 week program (MSSA CAD) that you do not need to be an expert in any one thing when you are creating software but instead have a commitment to know you don't know anything and the drive to keep learning more.

Technology is constantly evolving, now more then ever, and it allows me to constantly have something new to learn, from my Dating Application that utilizes Angular and ASP NET CORE to my (one day will be perfect I hope) Third-Person Shooter created in Unreal Engine 4 that brings C++, a powerful engine, and a dream to life all the way down to my first "Hello World!" program I hope to inspire and innovate through my passion and commitment to learn and teach.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Working with a growth mindset determined to ensure everyday, whether logged into teams or not, I learn something new I can utilize to better help the world solve problems. 

-Develop internal systems to assist with the handling of large volumes of data across multiple systems handling millions of dollars worth of billing data to ensure accurate billing across Azure.

-Work closely with various cloud systems in Azure to develop a robust system that connects and authenticates securely in Microsoft's cloud.

-Troubleshooting and fixing both live and test errors with short turnaround to ensure all of our systems and resources are functioning both securely and efficiently.

positions.title: Microsoft Software and Systems Academy Cloud Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Successfully completed an 18-week program that taught the skills necessary to become a Software Engineer through development of Technical and professional skills as well as working on real-world projects.

•	Worked heavily in groups to learn and tutor complex topics to develop real world web applications such as e-commerce and portfolio websites.

•	Developed a dating application which utilized ASPNET Core and Angular which allows users to register, publish photos, ‘like’ other users, and chat with users that liked them back. Applied authentication and encryption to allow users to securely connect to the application while keeping their credentials secure.

•	Worked with Unreal Engine and C++ to create a custom Third-Person game that had custom scripts for advanced movement. Utilized behavior trees and custom pathing to create dynamic enemies that chase the player through levels.

positions.title: Orderly Room Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Served as an adviser of all personnel functions; managed, processed, reviewed, and coordinated administrative tasks pertaining to personnel accountability, strength management, evaluations, awards, and legal actions. 

•	Supervised, mentored, and was responsible for the health, welfare, morale, training, and actions of four Soldiers.

•	Successfully planned and executed the deployment of 218 Soldiers to Germany and redeployed them.

•	Created and implemented multiple systems and processes for Covid-19 safety and mitigation while keeping mission requirements at the forefront.

positions.title: 15Y - AH-64D ARMAMENT/ELECTRICAL/AVIONICS SYSTEMS REPAIRER
positions.description:
•	Set-up and performed diagnostics on specified aircraft using training manuals, electronics repair software programs, blueprints and schematics

•	Lead small groups of Soldiers in FARP Operations to fuel, reload, and troubleshoot aircraft in a live fire environment.

•	Completed over 1600 hours of scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on the AH-64D utilizing diagnostic and troubleshooting skills while communicating your finds to teammates.

positions.title: AH-64D(E) Armament, Electrical, and Avionic Systems Repairer
positions.description: Focused on results-driven troubleshooting with strict time-sensitive deadlines. Part of the downed aircraft recovery team with specialized training in troubleshooting and leading investigations. Developed and implemented standards for component testing and replacement with a goal time of one week from start to test flight.
